claims.text: FAERS shows disproportionate reporting of thrombocytopenia with niraparib (PRR 9.863, IC025 3.179); this is a signal of disproportionate reporting, not proof of causation.
Thrombocytopenia is listed in the Warnings and Precautions section of the ZEJULA label.
Because the PRR is 9.863, niraparib caused the thrombocytopenia in this patient.
About 12.5% of niraparib-treated patients develop thrombocytopenia according to FAERS.
The boxed warning of the label describes fatal thrombocytopenia.
The patient should restart niraparib at a lower dose once her platelets recover.
